shell.impersonation: Support view: {workspace} — WRITING IS BLOCKED, the view expires at {expires}.

dashboard.title: Overview
dashboard.noAccess: You are not allowed to view the log.
dashboard.unverifiedWarning: You have an unverified domain — ventMail will not send from it.

domains.title: Domains
domains.name: Domain
domains.empty: No domains yet — sending requires a verified domain.
domains.unverified: {count} domain(s) are not verified — ventMail will not send from them.

apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.name: Name
apiKeys.channelsHint: Leave empty to allow every channel.
apiKeys.issuedOnce: This key is shown ONCE. Copy it now — afterwards only the prefix remains.

smtp.title: SMTP credentials
smtp.name: Name
smtp.domainHint: Bound to a domain, the credential may only send from it.
smtp.channelHint: A marketing credential cannot send transactional mail — and vice versa.
smtp.issuedOnce: The password is shown ONCE. Copy it now — it cannot be recovered, only reissued.
smtp.relayNote: No open relay: every SMTP submission is authenticated, TLS-only, and passes the same PreSendGate as the API.

suppressions.title: Suppression list
suppressions.note: The suppression list is the PreSendGate's second gate: nothing is sent to an address on it.
suppressions.scopeHint: "marketing" blocks marketing only; "all" blocks transactional too.
suppressions.added: Address added to the suppression list.
suppressions.missing: This address is not on the suppression list.
suppressions.irrevocable: Complaint- and unsubscribe-based suppressions cannot be removed: that is the recipient's will.

webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.name: Name
webhooks.urlHint: Only a public https address is accepted (SSRF protection).
webhooks.eventsHint: Leave empty to receive every event.
webhooks.secretOnce: The signing secret is shown ONCE. Copy it now.
webhooks.deadLetterWarning: {count} delivery/deliveries went to dead-letter — fix the endpoint, then replay.
webhooks.noEndpoints: No endpoints yet — without one no delivery chain starts.

ipPools.title: IP pools and warmup
ipPools.quarantinedWarning: {count} IP(s) are quarantined — the rest carry more volume, which during warmup costs reputation.
ipPools.warmupNote: {count} IP(s) are warming up: the daily cap grows gradually, and mail above it is DELAYED, not lost.
ipPools.empty: No IP is assigned to this workspace.

deliverability.title: Deliverability
deliverability.listedWarning: {count} blocklist hit(s) — your customers notice this before we do: suddenly nobody receives their mail.
deliverability.dmarcHint: Under `p=none` a failure has no consequence yet — but it shows what would happen under `p=reject`.
deliverability.unverified: {count} domain(s) are unverified — the PreSendGate will not send from them.

validation.title: Address validation
validation.probeNote: The mailbox probe is rate-limited and cached: receivers punish frequent probing, which is why there is no "validate everything" button.

billing.title: Billing
billing.suspendedWarning: The account is SUSPENDED for non-payment — sending stops at the fourth gate. Settling restores it immediately.

audience.title: Audience
audience.name: Name
audience.unconfirmedWarning: {count} contact(s) have no confirmed marketing consent — the third gate will not send marketing to them.
audience.listDescriptionHint: Recipients see this in the preference center.

templates.title: Templates
templates.name: Name
templates.subject: Subject
templates.preheaderHint: The short text shown after the subject in the mailbox list.
templates.previewEmpty: Add a block to see the preview.
templates.unsubscribeRequired: A marketing template MUST contain an unsubscribe block — saving is rejected without it.

campaigns.title: Campaigns
campaigns.name: Name
campaigns.subject: Subject
campaigns.lockedReason: While sending, content and targeting cannot be changed: sending half a campaign elsewhere is worse than waiting.
campaigns.fromHint: Only a verified domain may send — the first gate checks this.
campaigns.localTimeHint: The time is interpreted in the chosen timezone — "09:00" alone means nothing.
campaigns.weightHint: A percentage. The variant weights must add up to exactly 100 before sending.
campaigns.abHint: Variants can only be added while the campaign is a draft: the split is decided when sending starts.
campaigns.variantSingle: A single variant is not an A/B test — either two or more, or none.

journeys.title: Journeys
journeys.name: Name
journeys.triggerHint: This starts the sequence — spoofable triggers are throttled separately by the engine.
journeys.idleWarning: {count} active journey/journeys have no running instance — the trigger probably never fires.
journeys.noSteps: This journey has no step yet.
journeys.activationNote: Activation VALIDATES the chain: in a cyclic or exit-less sequence recipients would be stuck.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.empty: No sent campaign yet — a report exists only for what went out.
analytics.mppNote: The open rate is DISTORTED: Apple Mail Privacy Protection prefetches images, so some opens are machine-made. A click is a deliberate action — look at that.

platform.title: Platform console
platform.unhealthyWarning: {count} component(s) are not healthy (overall: {status}) — "unknown" is NOT green, we simply do not know.
platform.reasonHint: Support ticket number or description — "just looking" is not an acceptable reason to open someone else\u2019s account.
platform.sendQuotaHint: Leave empty to keep the plan quota.
platform.expiresHint: Required: an expired override lapses on its own, no revocation needed.
platform.globalSuppressionNote: A global suppression affects EVERY tenant and blocks at the second gate. It cannot be added without a reason — and removing it is the graver act.
platform.detailHint: At a later reputation review this is what explains why it was added.
platform.actionHint: A prefix is enough: "platform." returns every platform action.

members.title: Members and access
members.heading: Members
members.note: Sign-in goes through ventSSO — this screen decides access, not passwords.
members.name: Name
members.inviteHint: The invitation belongs to the address: the roles take effect when that person signs in with ventSSO. We do not create users.
members.subAccountsHint: A sub-account is a separate workspace with its own domains, suppression list and logs. Isolation is as strict as between two unrelated customers.
members.subAccountLocked: This workspace is itself a sub-account — the hierarchy is single-level, so no further one can be created below it.
members.parentIs: This workspace is a sub-account of {name}.
members.lockedRoles: Roles you cannot edit (stronger than yours): {roles}
members.inviteLogged: The invitation e-mail also appears in the workspace message log, like every outgoing message.

forms.title: Signup forms
forms.note: The form lives on your site, we provide the endpoint. A submission never grants consent by itself: the confirmation e-mail decides.
forms.name: Name
forms.minSecondsHint: A faster submission is a bot. It cannot be switched off.
forms.consentTextHint: This goes into the evidence — for a regulator the wording is the answer.
forms.consentDefault: I agree to receive the newsletter at this address.
forms.policyVersionHint: Which privacy notice was in force.
forms.redirectUrlHint: Only to your own verified domain — otherwise we show the thank-you page.

storedTemplates.title: Stored templates
storedTemplates.note: These are the transactional sending templates: versions are immutable, a change creates a new version.
storedTemplates.empty: No stored templates yet — the `/v1/templates` API creates them.
storedTemplates.tooLarge: Comparison does not run above {lines} lines — download the versions through the API.
storedTemplates.identical: The two versions are IDENTICAL — no differences.

invitations.title: Your invitations
invitations.note: The invitation belongs to your address. Until you accept, the inviting organisation sees nothing about you; declining deletes the invitation.
invitations.unverified: ventSSO has not verified this e-mail address yet, so the invitation cannot be accepted.
